newsitem.title: FRANCE: French public sector wage rises outstrip private.
newsitem.headline: French public sector wage rises outstrip private.

text.p: French public sector salary increases outpaced wage gains in the private sector last year, statistics institute INSEE said on Friday.
It said annual wages of public sector employees rose 1.8 percent, in real terms, to an average of 139,500 francs, while private sector wages rose 0.4 percent for an annual average of 124,720 francs.

The salary range was narrower, however, in the public sector where the highest paid 10 percent earned 2.4 times more than the lowest paid 10 percent. In the private sector, the highest paid 10 percent earned 2.9 times more than the lowest paid.
